for i in range(input_image.shape[0]):
    for j in range(input_image.shape[1]):
        for k in range(input_image.shape[2]):

# Run the pipeline to generate the output image
output_buffer = hl.Buffer(hl.UInt(8), (20, 40, 3))

# Convert the output buffer back to a NumPy array

    for j in range(output_buffer.shape[1]):
